front: Three rules for a fair comparison?
back: Same folds and data, include simple baselines, and check that the gap is not just noise.
The accuracy gain of a model over a simple baseline such as seasonal naive. No gain means no value.

front: Why geometric mean for relative errors?
back: Ratios multiply. The geometric mean of 0.5 and 2 is 1, so a win and a loss of equal size cancel.

front: What does the Diebold-Mariano test check?
back: Whether the mean difference of the losses of two forecasts on the same points is zero.
The best of many tested models has an optimistic score because of selection. Use an untouched final period.
It treats every series equally and is not dominated by series with large values.
